checkpoint_approvals.comment: Approved as Functional Analyst; story points confirmed at 8 (kept — the producer+approver reframe reviewed: integrated narrative, AC-1..AC-11, rule #4 producers-first, Impact option A; governance solid per ADR-007/008; evidence gate clean, 0 OQs). Authorizes decomposition into 4 candidate functional Bolts.

Re-approved (material change, G15 — the delivered state evolved): AC-1/AC-5 reflect the actual deliverable — no agents/coordinator/ folder, no generated coordinator sub-agent; the Coordinator is the Avenga DevFlow platform agent itself, evolved (ADR-007 §3.4), with the orchestrator identity in the four platform files; the generator produces only role agents. First approval (15:50:52) kept as history.

Re-approved (revision 3, material change G15 — ship model + agents/ examples–squad split) after ADR-013's acceptance (2026-08-24): AC-9/rule #7 per ADR-013 §3.9 (no pre-built role wrappers; the Coordinator projects from squad/ and installs; generator + parity stay a maintainer invariant); AC-1/AC-2 split agents/roles/ into examples/ (shipped read-only references) + squad/ (the project's live agents, the only folder the roster references), TEMPLATE-new-role/ at the family root; BOLT-005 added. Prior approvals (15:50:52, 17:30:48) kept as history. Authorizes creating BOLT-005.
